name: Payment-Mandate agent — 8-case golden set (D34 locale spread)
description: Phase 3.11 golden set per payment_mandate.spec.md §7. Mix of valid mandate composition / pipa-missing / unsupported-currency / ttl-out-of-range / prompt-injection / amount-below-floor across the 4 D34 locales. The mandate_validity criterion (≥ 0.98) measures schema validity (jti uniqueness, expiresAt > now+1h, positive amount). Per D27, requiresHumanApproval must be true on every successful case. UUIDv7 mandateId + nonce + RFC-3339 expiresAt are agent-generated; the eval's final_response_match_v2 tolerates the variance via the criteria_overrides below.

metadata.ec_2_29_nonce_check: every successful case must produce distinct UUIDv7 mandateId + nonce; verifier rejects duplicates within rolling 48h window (R1 in AP2-UX.md §10)
